text.description_html:
Stainless Steel Fusion SF-A2 Lever And 100-A2 Deadbolt

Made for heavy duty security, this stainless steel deadbolt and lever entryset has a limited lifetime warranty. Going with the saying: what is old is new again, the redolent shape of the SF-A2 door lever is a great way to add a little retro flair to your home but in a very contemporary way. This Fusion made stainless steel door handle and lock is basic enough in its design to beautifully integrate into any décor; but what is most appealing about this entry set is that it’s timeless. Instead of just another plain door lever and deadbolt, this fashionable entry set can just as easily hearken back to images of vintage homes, as it can meld into modern-day minimalism, or exude its charming sci-fi qualities—all while adding just the right amount of interesting detail to your doors. It is available in Brushed Stainless Steel and Polished Stainless Steel finishes. It has an optional 2-3/8" or 2-3/4" backset.

Also Available Matching SF-A2 Stainless Steel Leverset

Features of the Retro Stainless Steel SF-A2 Lever and 100-A2 Deadbolt Set:

  • 1" throw bolt with Interior roll pins.
  • Heavy-Duty strike with 3 screws for added security.
  • Solid brass Schlage SC1 keyway & 5 pin system.
  • Cycle tested to ANSI standards.
  • ”Positive Stop” lever spring mechanism
  • Reversible Latchbolt in matching/coordinating finish
  • Easy assembly of leverset with alignment block and rose posts
  • Includes passage function door leverset and single cylinder deadbolt.

Specifications of the Fusion Stainless Steel SF-A2 Lever With 100-A2 Deadbolt Entryset:

  • Deadbolt Diameter: 2-7/8"
  • Deadbolt Projection: 1"
  • Lever Length: 4"
  • Lever Projection: 2-1/8"
  • Rose Diameter: 2-7/8"
  • Rose Projection: 3/8"
  • Adjustable Door Thickness 1-1/4" to 2"
  • Backsets: Either 2-3/8" or 2-3/4"
  • Standard Latch Rotation is 40 Degrees.
  • Material: Stainless Steel
  • Lifetime Limited Warranty on workmanship, materials, and operation.

The Single Cylinder Deadbolt is thrown and retracted by a key from the exterior and a thumbturn from the interior while the Passage Lever Set latch operates from either side of door by using a spindle.
